disable_host_txs_alternative.existing_control: TxSTypeCtlPerPktType: host/MCU enable masks indexed by packet type/subtype, not BSS. WlanIdx mask is separate and not per-BSS beacon selection.
disable_host_txs_alternative.dependency: Beacon DMA completion changes WRITE_TO_DMA to DMA_DONE; BcnTxSHandler returns it to IDLE. APUpdateBeaconFrame non-IDLE path invokes queue recovery or returns.
disable_host_txs_alternative.verdict: No safe per-IoT TxS-off equivalent proven. Global host beacon TxS disable could affect Main/Guest and stall beacon scheduling. Not implemented.
disable_host_txs_alternative.distinction: TxS reports are distinct from MCU ACK; neither safety mechanism is disabled.

retained_buffer_followup.observed: RT28xx_UpdateBeaconToAsic obtains bcn_buf->BeaconPkt and passes packet/buffer to HAL_KickOutMgmtTx, then marks WRITE_TO_DMA. No per-submission clone in this caller.
retained_buffer_followup.limit: HAL mapping and packet lifetime must be inspected before claiming aliasing or use-after-free; this caller alone does not prove either.
retained_buffer_followup.next: trace HAL_KickOutMgmtTx implementation and DMA cell ownership before considering callback changes harmless

dma_chain.submission: MT7603 Q_IDX_BCN selects BcnRing cell; maps pSrcBufVA directly via PCI_MAP_SINGLE, stores same pPacket and mapping, fills SDPtr0/SDLen0 and advances hardware cidx. No packet clone in this function.
dma_chain.reap: Beacon completion advances to hardware didx, PCI_UNMAP_SINGLE, clears cell pNdisPacket, then changes WRITE_TO_DMA to DMA_DONE.
dma_chain.conclusion: Retained BSS allocation alone does not demonstrate buffer immutability during active DMA. A stale callback changing state to IDLE may invalidate scheduling assumptions if hardware duplicate delivery exists. This is a conditional risk, not a demonstrated device failure.
dma_chain.host_check: PASS actual extracted WrBeaconDmaOutstanding ASan/UBSan existing owner/unknown/ring-mismatch/lock-release fixture. No target/device proof.

independent_dma_gate_review.existing_gate: wr_iot_bcn_producer_begin calls counted lifetime gate under BcnRingLock; multiple active producers permitted. APUpdateBeaconFrame and APMakeBssTimFrame use it.
independent_dma_gate_review.why_snapshot_insufficient: DMA snapshot locks internally and releases before caller mutates buffer. It neither reserves exclusive builder ownership nor excludes another subsequent submission. Holding BcnRingLock across builder would nest locks used by final submission/recovery.
implementation_requirements: inventory all BeaconPkt writers and all final submissions including APMakeAllBssBeacon
separate per-BSS exclusive builder ownership from counted lifetime pins
reserve builder and confirm no mapped cell for same packet before first buffer write under compatible lock ordering
ensure close revocation waits for builder and publication, retain Main/Guest unaffected
test concurrent builders, DMA completion, stale TxS, close/reopen and failure paths on actual transformed code
independent_dma_gate_review.status: design incomplete; no drop-in snapshot workaround applied; independent DMA safety alone does not prove RF/FIFO quiet
